data.name: Ethereal Storm
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Ethereal Storm

Dive into Ethereal Storm, the ultimate bullet hell experience that blends the best elements from beloved classics. Whether you're braving the chaos solo or teaming up with friends, Ethereal Storm delivers non-stop action, deep strategy, and endless replayability.

Key Features

  • Intense Bullet Hell Action — Dodge, weave, and obliterate waves of enemies in stunning top-down 3D environments.
  • FF5-Inspired Job System — Master dozens of unlockable jobs. Mix and match skills to create your ultimate build.
  • Layered Building System (AoE-Inspired) — Construct and upgrade your base with a deep, strategic building system.
  • Skyrim-Inspired Quest System — Explore expansive side quests, hidden secrets, and branching storylines.
  • 4-Player Co-op & Versus Modes — Team up with up to 3 friends in co-op or go head-to-head in versus matches!
  • Unlockable Characters — Discover and unlock a diverse roster of characters with unique abilities.
  • Top-Down 3D Graphics — Experience the chaos in beautiful top-down 3D visuals.
  • Cross-Platform — Available on Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS!

Game Modes

Co-op Campaign — Join forces with up to 3 friends. Coordinate job builds and conquer the storm as a team.
Versus Mode — Compete against friends in thrilling PvP battles.
Solo Run — Challenge yourself alone with maximum replayability.

data.short_description: Survive the Ethereal Storm — a thrilling 4-player co-op bullet hell with an FF5-inspired job system, layered building mechanics, and expansive Skyrim-style quests. Play solo or team up for explosive fun!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 470 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU, 4GB VRAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU, 8GB VRAM
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 470 (4GB VRAM, Vulkan)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.5 or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 (8GB VRAM, Vulkan)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
